INT001: Nile Pearl Hotel is located in Cairo, Egypt.
INT002: Nile Pearl Hotel is a 5-star hotel.
INT006: Early check-in is subject to room availability and hotel approval.
INT007: Late check-out is subject to availability and may incur an additional fee.
INT008: Guests are required to provide valid identification documents during check-in.
INT009: Nile Pearl Hotel offers Standard, Deluxe, Superior, Family, and Executive rooms.
INT010: Room capacity depends on the room type. Standard and Deluxe rooms accommodate up to 2 guests, Superior rooms up to 3 guests, and Family rooms up to 4 guests. Executive Room capacity is not specified.
INT011: Room amenities vary by room type and may include private bathrooms, Wi-Fi, air conditioning, televisions, comfortable beds, and upgraded amenities.
INT012: Children are welcome. Extra beds or additional accommodation are subject to room capacity and availability.
INT013: The booking process includes selecting dates, selecting a room, providing guest information, reviewing the reservation, and confirming the booking.
INT014: Booking information may include the guest's full name, number of guests, check-in date, check-out date, selected room type, contact information, and payment information when required.
INT015: Guests may contact customer service to request reservation changes. Changes are subject to availability and hotel approval.
INT016: A reservation should be confirmed after the required booking information has been provided and the reservation process has been completed.
INT017: Guests can contact customer service to request cancellation assistance and should provide the relevant reservation details.
INT018: Cancellation eligibility depends on the conditions associated with the reservation.
INT019: Any applicable cancellation fees depend on the cancellation conditions associated with the reservation.
INT020: The current hotel knowledge base does not specify the exact payment methods accepted by the hotel. Guests should contact customer service for current information.
INT021: Payment requirements depend on the selected reservation and applicable hotel policies.
INT022: Additional charges may apply for certain hotel services or damages to hotel property.
INT023: Refund eligibility depends on the conditions associated with the reservation.
INT024: Eligible refunds are processed according to the applicable payment and refund conditions. The current knowledge base does not specify a fixed refund processing time.
INT025: Daily breakfast is available from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM at the main restaurant.
INT027: Room service is available 24/7. Guests can order food and beverages directly to their rooms.
INT028: Airport transfer is available upon request and costs 800 EGP per trip.
INT029: Laundry and dry cleaning are available daily and laundry service costs 200 EGP per kilogram.
INT030: Spa treatments are available from 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM and cost 1,200 EGP per session.
INT031: The hotel gym is available 24/7 for hotel guests.
INT032: The main restaurant provides daily breakfast from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM. The current knowledge base does not specify restaurant services outside breakfast.
INT033: Free Wi-Fi is available 24/7 in all guest rooms and public areas.
INT034: Parking is available for hotel guests.
INT035: The swimming pool is available for hotel guests from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM.
INT036: Pets are not allowed inside the hotel, including guest rooms and hotel facilities.
INT037: Smoking is not permitted inside guest rooms or indoor public areas. Designated smoking areas are available.
INT039: Guests who lose an item should contact the front desk. Items found on hotel property are handled by the hotel's Lost and Found department.
INT040: Guests should maintain reasonable noise levels, especially during nighttime hours.
INT041: Guests are expected to respect hotel property, staff, and other guests. Damage to hotel property may result in additional charges.
INT042: Guest information is handled according to the hotel's privacy and security procedures. The current knowledge base does not provide the complete privacy policy or specific data retention periods.
INT043: In case of an emergency, guests should contact the hotel reception immediately. Reception operates 24/7.
